blocked_on.detail: scripts/fetch_roboflow_froth.py reads the key only from the ROBOFLOW_API_KEY environment variable. No Roboflow credential exists in the CAOS_MANAGE vault (credentials/providers/ has no roboflow entry). This is the single external input standing between the repository and a real held-out lane.
